title: New advisor: the first two weeks
purpose: Onboarding checklist for a new service advisor, written when the newcomer started.
facts: Week one: shadow a lead; no solo quotes or promises; six pages to read in order; five of slot 16's calls; half days with slot 8 and slot 9; ten supervised check-ins.
Week two: calls with three reviewed a day; every estimate read by the lead; one till close with slot 3; chats.
Sign-off list of five points (prices, promises, the 10 % rule, the Walk-in record, which shop).
Written the week slot 7 started (the Monday of week T-14); it says the service pages are not where prices live, about eleven weeks before he quoted from one (S8 at T-12 days): he had been told.

list_items.item: You sit beside a lead advisor. You do not quote a price or promise a time on your own this week. Nobody will mind you saying "let me check that".
Read, in this order: the price list, Taking a call, Booking a visit, Checking a car in, Discount policy, Warranty.
Listen to five of Angie's calls. Write down what she does after she says the price.
Half a day in the shop with Randy: an oil service, a brake inspection, a tire off the rim. You will explain these fifty times a day.
Half a day with Marcus in the parts cage.
Check in ten cars with someone watching.

list_items.section: Week two: do it, with a net
list_items.item: You take calls. Your lead listens to three a day and tells you one thing to fix.

list_items.section: Week two: do it, with a net
list_items.item: You write estimates. Your lead reads every one before it goes.

list_items.section: Week two: do it, with a net
list_items.item: You close the till once, with Donna beside you.

list_items.section: Week two: do it, with a net
list_items.item: You answer chats. Read the draft before you send it.

list_items.section: Before you are on your own
list_items.item: [ ] You can find any price in under a minute, and you know the service pages are not where prices live.

list_items.section: Before you are on your own
list_items.item: [ ] You know what you may promise about time, and what you may not.

list_items.section: Before you are on your own
list_items.item: [ ] You know the 10 % rule and who approves above it.

list_items.section: Before you are on your own
list_items.item: [ ] You have never used the Walk-in customer.

list_items.section: Before you are on your own
list_items.item: [ ] You know which shop you are in when you answer the phone.

notes_for_russian_writer: Same plan; Russian new advisor is slot 7.
